title: Great God, at Thy Command
description: Great God, at Thy Command in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 863 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Summer”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Short Metre (6.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Great God, at thy com-mand, Sea-sons in or-der rise: Thy power and love in con-cert reign Through earth, and seas, and skies.

lines: Thy power and love in concert reign
Through earth, and seas, and skies.
How warm the sun's bright beams!
While, to refresh the ground, the rains
While grass, and herbs, and waving corn,
By him forgiveness, peace, and joy,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
